description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling streaming responses and errors from Cohere language models, including parsing streaming chunks, managing iterators, and handling different chunk types for Cohere's API.

classes.name: CohereError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Cohere-related errors, extending BaseLLMException.

classes.name: CohereModelInfo
classes.description: Provides model information and utility functions for Cohere models, including route determination and environment validation.

classes.name: ModelResponseIterator
classes.description: Handles streaming response iteration and chunk parsing for Cohere models, supporting both sync and async iteration.

classes.name: CohereV2ModelResponseIterator
classes.description: Specialized iterator for parsing Cohere v2 streaming chunks, with methods to handle different chunk types and extract relevant data.

methods.name: get_provider_info
methods.description: Returns provider-specific model info; default implementation returns None.

methods.name: get_models
methods.description: Returns a list of supported models; default implementation returns an empty list.

methods.name: get_api_key
methods.description: Static method to retrieve API key.

methods.name: get_api_base
methods.description: Static method to retrieve API base URL.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and prepares headers for Cohere API requests.

methods.name: get_base_model
methods.description: Returns the base model name from a given model string.

methods.name: get_cohere_route
methods.description: Determines the API route version ('v1' or 'v2') based on the model name.

methods.name: chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses a chunk dictionary into a GenericStreamingChunk object.

methods.name: convert_str_chunk_to_generic_chunk
methods.description: Converts a string or bytes chunk into a GenericStreamingChunk object.
